content.text:
Here are **free online auto repair estimate options** you can try:

### Best for mechanical repairs / maintenance
1. **RepairPal Estimator** — good for fair-price ranges by ZIP code, vehicle, and repair type. It also lists RepairPal-certified shops and may offer a 30-day price guarantee at participating shops. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))  
2. **YourMechanic Estimates** — free instant estimates for many common repairs and maintenance services; it shows pricing for mobile mechanic service. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))  

### Best for body damage / collision estimates from photos
3. **Otto Fix It** — upload damage photos and get a free AI preliminary estimate, plus possible quotes from nearby body shops. ([ottofixit.com](https://www.ottofixit.com/free-car-repair-estimate?utm_source=openai))  
4. **VTCCO** — free AI collision/body-damage estimate from uploaded photos; mainly positioned for accident/collision help and notes that final costs require shop/adjuster inspection. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))  
5. **CarAid** — provides photo-based repair estimates with AI plus human review; offers a free 3–5 business day option. ([caraid.us](https://www.caraid.us/?utm_source=openai))  

### Quick tip
Use these as a **ballpark estimate**, not a final price. Actual cost can change after a mechanic or body shop inspects the vehicle, especially if there’s hidden damage, diagnostics needed, rust, seized parts, or required recalibration.

If you tell me your **year/make/model, ZIP code, and the repair needed** — or describe the damage — I can help you narrow down what estimate tool to use and what price range to expect.
